newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech state agency says 1990-96 FDI totals $7.2bln.
newsitem.headline: Czech state agency says 1990-96 FDI totals $7.2bln.

text.p: The investment promotion agency Czechinvest said on Thursday that foreign direct investment (FDI) into the Czech Republic increased by $500 million in the fourth quarter of last year.
This brought total post-communist FDI since 1990 to $7.2 billion. The cumulative total up to the end of the third quarter was $6.7 billion.
The figures appeared in a statement by the state-run Czechinvest citing Czech National Bank preliminary data.
CNB officials were not immediately available to confirm Czechinvest's report.

Czechinvest released the statement, following its earlier announcement of a new greenfield project in which Japan's Toray Industries Inc. agreed to build a new polyester weaving and dyeing plant in the Czech city of Prostejov.

The latest statement said that Toray had committed to $50 million in investment. The Czech news agency CTK quoted Czechinvest director Jan Havelka as saying Toray's total investment would eventually be around $150 million.
